prerequisites: None. Competences taught in the advanced modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have advanced in-depth knowledge and skills in a selected specialized area of computer science
can report on current research results and deal with research literature

can apply working methods from computer science to the selected specialized area of computer science (developing and applying fundamental solution strategies and their formal description, training abstraction skills, system development)
are able to apply scientific working methods to independently solve problems and communicate the solution
have acquired competences preferably in the field of Artificial Intelligence

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50 percent of points)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Written exam or oral exam (individual exam)

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire the ECTS points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The examination performance is a written or oral individual exam.
